Campaign B cell launcher: spawns the bwrap binary only; argv is built from a human-signed mount template with dual-fetch identity checks, and the cell payload executes inside the cage. Refuses unsigned templates fail-closed.

Registered out-of-cage executor for seat-driven sandbox tests: spawns only 'node cellwrap.mjs spawn' (bwrap cells from signed templates, shell target, root allowlist); never executes request payloads as host commands.
Unit tests for cellrunner: spawn the runner CLI in a child process to assert validator fail-closed behavior.
